towns.reason: Cloudflare bot challenge (HTTP 403, cf-mitigated: challenge) on every page of townofbecket.org; not bypassed. becketma.gov is a parked domain.
WordPress site has no agenda listing: board pages link only to minutes (Google Drive / ASUS WebStorage folders). Agendas appear to be posted physically at Town Hall.

CivicPlus AgendaCenter is empty; agendas live on Granicus (framinghamma.granicus.com/ViewPublisher.php?view_id=24), whose robots.txt disallows all user agents except named search engines. Older documents are in Laserfiche WebLink.
Cloudflare 'Attention Required' block (HTTP 403) on middleboroughma.gov; legacy middleborough.com unreachable (upstream 502). Not bypassed.
Agendas & Minutes page (/meetings) is rendered client-side from api.heygov.com, and that API's robots.txt disallows all crawling. Would need a headless browser plus permission.

barnstable.gov sits behind a Cloudflare bot challenge. The legacy host tobweb.town.barnstable.ma.us serves the same board pages without it, but crawling that would sidestep the town's bot protection, so it is disabled pending permission. Listings below are ready to enable.
